## Contribution checks

- [ ] The PR targets `main` from a dedicated branch and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] The primary tablet layout and quiet monochrome reading behavior are preserved.
- [ ] Original user documents remain intact; third-party material has attribution and permission.
